description: Election Commission - A member has Vacated his Office of member of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically declares that a member of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a direct notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance concerning an electoral matter (vacation of office by an elected member), making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7).
